trades.name: LBAF of today's low
trades.quote: A LBAF of today’s low has reason to work. 6775 ES has been super key and sits just below. I considered using as a daily level perhaps somewhere in the 72-75 range but it would need to produce a LBAF anyway. As mentioned above 6792-6794 would need to be reclaimed so this could be a bit tricky and therefore rates perhaps a tad lower to me.

trades.name: LBAF of 6792-6794
trades.quote: A LBAF of 6792-6794 is a higher probability trade with risk easier to manage (the low which produced the LBAF). Mindful of 6803.5-6808.5 (possibly up to 10-11) from below, this can find 15 and 18-22 with potential for 30 and today’s high.
trades.stop_hint: risk easier to manage (the low which produced the LBAF)

trades.name: LAAF of 6831.25 (ARH)
trades.quote: Short a LAAF of 6831.25 targeting 18-22, 15, and 6803.5-6808.5 primarily. monitor for continuation from there.

trades.name: Session downtrend after rejection near 6830 (no sweep of 6831.25)
trades.quote: Given how active sellers were up there, I would be okay joining a session downtrend following a rejection near 6830 that doesn’t sweep 31.25 first.

trades.name: Breakdown short: 6783-6787 flips to resistance through today's low
trades.quote: I don’t love breakdown shorts but given the pocket of air below price, if 6783-6787 flips to resistance through today’s low, we can be short on a tight leash for fill of the overnight singles toward 40-46 and 34.25 (mindful of 60-64).

trades.name: LBAF of today's low
trades.quote: A LBAF of today’s low for a long on NQ is far cleaner than for ES. I would feel a bit more comfortable in seeing 25090-25116 once through 24993-24998 or so.

trades.name: Short if 25090-25116 remains offered
trades.quote: If 25090-25116 remains offered I am open to shorts given today’s excess high and heavy VPOC but I rate it pretty low. I would want ES to confirm weakness probably.
trades.stop_hint: I would want ES to confirm weakness probably.

trades.name: LAAF of 25157.5

trades.name: Breakdown short below today's low
